name: context-to-workspace
query: Create an operations home from our onboarding notes and existing process docs. Create it under https://notion.so/team-home.

context.conversation: Laptop setup needs a checklist. Equipment requests have no owner yet. Link our policies; do not copy them.

sources.https://notion.so/team-home: Empty authorized destination. No existing workspace or tracker.
sources.https://notion.so/source: Process notes: request a laptop, then IT enrolls it. Security policy lives at https://notion.so/security-policy. The equipment request has no agreed due date.

search_routes.intent: Find source material for the requested workspace

success_criteria: Links the authoritative security policy without copying it, distinguishes laptop setup steps from the individual equipment request, and leaves its owner and due date unknown.
Uses chat context without asking the user to restate it; fetches the source and destination before populating.
Creates a populated home with working navigation, clear hierarchy, and a first action; links source material and preserves original notes.
Verifies populated content and view semantics; reports visual inspection honestly.
